messages:
emma: Heads-up: CI failing in analytics service after bumping to redwood-inference 0.12. Tests show typing-extensions conflicts during pip install. Anyone seen this?

raj: I saw something similar last week. Poetry lock had typing-extensions pinned to 4.5 while the SDK wheel needs >=4.6 (transitive from a grpc dep).

maria: Can you paste the pip/poetry output and the CI install steps? also which Python version?

emma: CI snippet:
```
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install redwood-inference==0.12.0
```
Error shows: "Cannot install typing-extensions==4.5.* required by ..." and then it aborts. Using GH Actions ubuntu-latest, python 3.9.

josh: Quick note: if you export requirements from poetry then pip-install additional packages afterwards, you can re-resolve or create conflicts. Two patterns that work: (1) install the SDK first, then install exported lockfile; or (2) pin typing-extensions explicitly in the exported requirements.

lia: From the SDK docs we recommend either using poetry end-to-end or install the wheel directly. Workaround in CI: `python -m pip install --upgrade "typing-extensions>=4.6"` as a pre-step. That usually unblocks pip resolver.

maria: Also the package includes stubs and ships py.typed — if your environment has an older typing-extensions backport (py<3.10 combos) you'll hit incompatibility. For 3.8/3.9 pin to 4.6+ is fine.

raj: For the streaming hang you mentioned elsewhere: if you use httpx AsyncClient make sure tests run async. Mixing starlette TestClient (sync) with Async streaming endpoints will deadlock. Use `async with client.stream(...)` pattern.

emma: Ah — our integration tests use TestClient (sync) which would explain the hang on streaming tests.

josh: Workarounds for tests: run streams in pytest-asyncio or mock the streaming response with pytest-httpx. Also avoid mixing `requests`-style clients with httpx async streams.

lia: Slight API note: python SDK has both sync and async helpers. For async streaming use the Async client: `from redwood import AsyncClient; async with AsyncClient(...) as c: async for chunk in c.generate_stream(...): ...` — that pattern is safer in CI async tests.

emma: Thanks — I switched those tests to pytest-asyncio and added a pre-step to lift typing-extensions. Quick fix: `pip install "typing-extensions>=4.6" && pip install redwood-inference==0.12.0` — CI now passes locally. Opening PR with the change.

deps-bot: Dependency update available: redwood-inference 0.12.1 — release notes say it loosens typing-extensions pin. See #pkg-updates.

raj: Nice. Once PR is up ping me and I'll review. Also we should add a short note in devx docs about mixing sync tests + async streaming to avoid future surprises.

emma: Will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1428 (contains the CI change + test switch).

maria: Looks good, thanks for moving fast.

emma: Marking this resolved for now, will follow up if 0.12.1 causes any further diffs. :thumbsup:
